claim: RAUC v1.15.2 built unattended from the upstream tag (commit 4fb7c798d6ae412344fb8f8d310d773046af3441, tag object f1ceebd68b4edcf681c23d6a49aa5322d483c4d9) for arm64 and amd64 with Debian 13 libraries; the arm64 binary (sha256 7f076b8b…639d1f) and the git-archive source tarball (0332ba2a…cf75) are byte-identical to the LAB-rauc-1152 build, while the amd64 install tarball hash differs (7ec9ecf0… vs 0c241e9c…; cause not investigated).

RAUC 1.15 (released 2025-11-07) added booted-slot detection on UEFI systems from the BootCurrent variable (PR 1696) and changed the detection order so explicit bootloader-backend information is preferred over the root= kernel parameter (PR 1712); 1.14 (2025-04-02) added the prevent-late-fallback option.

In RAUC 1.15.2, get_bootname() checks the kernel command line for explicit markers first (rauc.external, root=/dev/nfs, rauc.slot=), then asks the bootloader backend (efi: match BootCurrent's entry name to a slot bootname, else error 'Current EFI bootentry not known to rauc!'), and only then falls back to root=. RAUC 1.13 read only the command line (rauc.slot=, then root=).

Lab T0: with RAUC 1.15.2 the X-2R build produced 10 UKIs whose sbverify results split as designed (v1–v3 OK, v4 tampered and v5 unsigned fail), 4 verity bundles plus 1 plain bundle verified against the lab CA, OVMF vars with only lab PK/KEK/db and SecureBootEnable ON, and an image with RAUC 1.15.2 and no Debian rauc package.

Lab (QEMU q35 + OVMF Secure Boot, custom keys, swtpm, x86_64 TCG): RAUC 1.15.2's efi backend with one signed UKI per slot passed the full X-2R suite in 2 runs: first boot under enforced Secure Boot with TPM2 (PCR 7) data unlock, A→B update via BootNext, health-gated rollback, firmware refusal (Access Denied) of a tampered and an unsigned UKI with fall-through to the committed slot in the same power-on, and data staying locked with Secure Boot off; signed PCR 11 bonus also passed.

Lab: the EFI variable effects of RAUC 1.15.2 matched Debian's 1.13 run step for step (BootOrder 0003 while B is written, BootNext 0004 after install, mark-good prepends the slot to BootOrder, mark-bad removes it); no behaviour change was observed in install, commit or rollback.

Lab T8: with bundle-formats=verity in system.conf, RAUC 1.15.2 refused a validly signed plain bundle under Secure Boot with 'Bundle format 'plain' not allowed'; no BootNext was set and BootOrder was unchanged (2 runs).

Lab T9/H4: with rauc.slot= hidden from RAUC 1.15.2 (bind-mounted /proc/cmdline), a normal boot of slot B was still reported as 'Booted from: rootfs.1 (OneMind-B)' with BootCurrent 0004 and no detection error, i.e. via BootCurrent; in the E1 state (BootCurrent 0001, a firmware auto-entry) RAUC logged 'efi backend: Current EFI bootentry not known to rauc!' and fell back to root=, reporting 'rootfs.0 (/dev/vda4)'. With rauc.slot= present (the shipped UKIs), the reported slot was unchanged from 1.13 in every test.

Lab E1 (pre-registered here, 2 repeats): the 1.13 downgrade gap persists on RAUC 1.15.2. With BootNext pointed at the firmware's removable-media auto-entry, the old validly signed factory UKI (v1) booted under Secure Boot on slot A's v5 root filesystem, PCR 7-bound data unlocked, and the health gate committed slot A (version 5), putting OneMind-A first in BootOrder again. RAUC version does not affect this; it is a Secure Boot/boot-path design issue (recommendations SB-3/SB-4 in secureboot-rauc).

RAUC's prevent-late-fallback=true (since 1.14) runs the equivalent of 'rauc status mark-bad other' after 'mark-good booted', so after a commit the other slot is no longer eligible for fallback; this does not remove firmware auto-entries or the ESP factory loader, and it was not tested in this lab.

Lab timing: every step of the 1.15.2 runs took about 1.4–2.5× longer than the 1.13 runs on the same emulator setup (total 1540 s and 1323 s vs 781 s and 818 s), including the Secure-Boot-off boot T6, which does not exercise RAUC; the slowdown is attributed to host load from other lab VMs (not isolated), not to RAUC.
